title: UAE Mandate e-invoicing
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
The UAE’s e-invoicing framework introduces a new operational reality: successfully issuing an invoice is no longer enough to keep transactions moving - required tax data must also be reported to the Federal Tax Authority (FTA). The UAE’s e-invoicing model requires invoice exchange and FTA reporting to work together, with tax data reported as part of the invoice flow.


The UAE uses a Peppol five-corner model, where the tax authority becomes part of the invoice flow. Businesses must manage both trading partner exchange and Tax Data Document (TDD) reporting to the FTA within the same compliance process.
